units.Description: Not stated in the release (written as n/a; BrainVision header 'unscaled'). The stored values have median absolute amplitudes of about 3e-5 to 2e-4, consistent with volts, but the release does not say so.

type.Description: SEEG for names 'POL <electrode letters><contact number>' (Nihon Kohden-style export names, kept verbatim). Depth contacts that the export put on the Nihon Kohden scalp/system slots are also SEEG (corrected in fix-20261030): 'EEG <S><n>-Ref' / 'POL <S><n>' whose shaft label <S> continues an SEEG shaft of the same file (e.g. EEG A1-Ref, EEG A2-Ref, POL A3 ... POL A10; EEG C1-Ref ... EEG C6-Ref, POL C7 ...; EEG F1-Ref ... EEG F10-Ref, POL F11 ...; P029 EEG Tp7-Ref ... EEG Tp10-Ref between POL Tp6 and POL Tp11), the P029 shaft 'Fp' (EEG Fp1-Ref, EEG Fp2-Ref, POL Fp3 ... POL Fp12: no scalp position Fp3 or above exists), 'EEG F1-Ref ... EEG F8/F10-Ref' in P010 and P020 (shaft F missing between the shafts E and G), and 'POL E1 ... POL E<N>' (shaft E between D and F; numbered 1..N without gaps, no other E shaft in the file). ECG for names containing ECG/EKG; MISC otherwise (e.g. 'POL E' without a number, the Nihon Kohden system reference input; 'POL A5A6-0'; 'POL DC<n>'; 'POL L', 'POL R'; P007 'POL E1', 'POL E2', 'POL E3-0' ... 'POL E16', whose naming is not regular). Types follow the channel names and their numbering in each released file; the release does not list channel types. The rule-by-rule list of changed rows is in code/fix-20261030_retype_log.tsv.
